## getPermit2PermitTypedData() function

Builds Permit2 allowance typed data for signing.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getPermit2PermitTypedData: (args: Permit2PermitArgs, chainId: ChainId) => TypedDataDefinition<typeof permit2PermitTypes, "PermitSingle">
```

```ts
import { ChainId } from "@morpho-org/blue-sdk";
import { getPermit2PermitTypedData } from "@morpho-org/blue-sdk-viem";
```
